_comment: Pterodactyl egg for a FRUKT Multiplayer dedicated server (FruktServer, no game or Wine needed).
name: FRUKT Dedicated Server
author: phoenix557@users.noreply.github.com
description: A dedicated server for the FRUKT Multiplayer mod (github.com/Phoenix557/Frukt-DedicatedServer). It runs no game, so it needs almost no CPU or memory; the players' games share the world. The installer puts FruktServer in the server's folder. Players join with the server's IP and port.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Downloads FruktServer from the latest GitHub release into the server's folder (/home/container).
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apt-get update >/dev/null 2>&1
    apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates >/dev/null 2>&1
fi

URL=https://github.com/Phoenix557/Frukt-DedicatedServer/releases/latest/download/FruktServer
echo "Downloading ${URL}"
curl -fsSL "${URL}" -o FruktServer.new
mv -f FruktServer.new FruktServer
chmod +x FruktServer
echo "Installed FruktServer ($(du -h FruktServer | cut -f1)). Start the server."

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list (up to 24 characters).

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map players load when they join: Yard, or any other FRUKT map name.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: How many players can join at once (1 to 16).

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: 1 downloads the newest FruktServer from GitHub releases on every start; 0 keeps the file you have.
